papers.title: Impact of Undertreated Antithrombotic Therapy on Adverse Patient Outcomes: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association.
papers.summary: American Heart Association scientific statement on antithrombotic undertreatment—omission, nonadherence, underdosing and subtherapeutic levels. Many patients with atrial fibrillation, venous thromboembolism or peripheral artery disease remain untreated or underdosed, raising ischaemic stroke, embolism, recurrent thrombosis and death. Antithrombotic stewardship and interprofessional care are urged to close these gaps.
papers.short_title: AHA scientific statement on undertreated antithrombotic therapy
